name: What is interior trim work, and what types are commonly installed?

mainEntity.name: What is interior trim work, and what types are commonly installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior trim work includes the decorative and functional woodwork installed along wall joints, openings, and ceilings. Common examples are baseboards, window casings, door casings, crown molding, chair rails, wainscoting, and picture frame molding. Beyond aesthetic appeal, trim seals gaps between flooring and drywall, conceals uneven plaster lines, and protects wall surfaces from scuffs and furniture impacts. When planning a project, consider the architectural profile and whether you plan to paint or stain the trim, as this dictates whether you should select primed pine, MDF, or solid hardwood.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior trim includes baseboards, crown molding, and door or window casings that hide wall seams, protect drywall, and elevate a room's architectural finish.
